name: notification-stack

frames.best_why: Frame 2 fans all four notification cards out in full, with icons, times and the header.

tagline: A stack of notification cards that fans open on hover and swipes off to dismiss.
summary: A short pile of notification cards showing app, message and time, with a count and a Show all toggle. Hovering fans them into a list, and swiping one or pressing its corner cross removes it.
appearance: A header row with Notifications, a count and a Show all link above stacked white rounded cards, each with a coloured app icon, a bold title, a grey body line and a time. Collapsed, the cards behind peek out as thin strips.
behaviour: Hovering or focusing fans the pile into a full list and the header flips to Show less. Dragging the front card sideways follows the pointer and, past a short distance or a quick flick, throws it off the edge while the rest close the gap.
demo_content: Four alerts: a message from Maya Chen, a design review, a paid invoice and a Blue Bottle card payment.
search_phrases: stack of alerts that fans out
card pile that opens on hover
use_when: A dashboard or inbox should show a few recent alerts without taking up a full panel.
avoid_when: Hover is the main way to expand it, so on touch the pile stays collapsed until you tap the header.
customise: Pass a notifications array of app, title, body, time and icon, and handle removals with onDismiss; the peek, gap and swipe thresholds are constants in the source.
weight_why: A handful of cards with a per-card requestAnimationFrame only during a swipe.

a11y.note: Strong coverage: cards expand on focus, Delete removes them, and focus moves on to the next card.

issues: Frame 5 catches the dismissed card as a faint red smear on the right that looks like a glitch.
Behind the front card the others show only a thin strip, so the pile's depth is easy to miss.
polish_why: Convincing fan and fling physics with clean cards; the collapsed pile hides its depth.
title: Notification Stack
